module: Facade of the photo mode integrated into the pause menu. It contains no logic: it loads the eight ui_photomode_* modules (session, camera, scene, effects, advancedRender, capture, preview, presets) and redirects about sixty functions to them via a FORWARDED_FUNCTIONS table. It also relays the engine hooks (capture metadata, pre-render, update, end of capture) to the right submodules.
notes: The redirected functions are generated dynamically at load time (M[name] = function(...) return _G[target][name](...) end); they therefore do not appear in the .md's static list. Examples: getCameraState, setCameraFov, setEffectsState, requestScreenshot, listPresets, applyPreset, beginPhotomodeSession, endPhotomodeSession, getRoutePayload. Their signature is that of the target function.

The target submodule of each function: session (session/panel/debug states, routes), camera (camera, camera bookmarks, FOV, speed, roll, exposure), scene (scene, environment bookmarks), effects, advancedRender, capture (captures, resolution), preview (preview, sharing), presets (presets).

dependencies.desc: List of the ui_photomode_* extensions loaded before this module.

onCollectScreenshotMetadata.desc: Hook called when collecting a capture's metadata; delegates to ui_photomode_preview.collectScreenshotMetadata.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering; delegates to ui_photomode_capture.handlePreRender.

onScreenshotAllDone.desc: Hook called when all requested captures are finished; delegates to ui_photomode_capture.onScreenshotAllDone.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame; delegates to ui_photomode_preview.handleUpdate.
